_comment: Vanilla village START template pools, extracted from the 26.2 dev bundle (net/minecraft/data/worldgen/*VillagePools.java). A StructureTemplatePool expands each (element, weight) pair into `weight` consecutive list entries in declaration order, and the zombie town centres are always declared LAST -- so the pick is a zombie village iff nextInt(total) >= zombie_from. Asserted contiguous at extraction time.
_biome_tags: data/minecraft/tags/worldgen/biome/has_structure/village_*.json -- the five lists are disjoint, so the biome alone determines the variant.
